Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Creative Concepts Studio specializes in providing innovative graphic design and commercial art services. Our operations encompass a wide range of design projects, including branding, marketing materials, digital content, and custom artwork. We prioritize creativity and professionalism while adhering to industry standards. We do not engage in high-risk activities like kiln firing or chemical treatments, ensuring a safe working environment. While we collaborate with subcontractors and freelance instructors, we maintain strict oversight and require proof of their insurance coverage to safeguard our operations. Our commitment to environmental responsibility is reflected in our sourcing practices, as we avoid the use of non-native or invasive plant species in any artwork we produce.
